title: SAE construction: other TopK dictionaries

conventions.fold_combination: within-seed: mean of fold AUCs; retrieval hits pooled over folds
conventions.difference: paired by seed, then mean and sample SD of the per-seed differences
conventions.ood_interval: saved 95% paired query bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 0

caption:
\textbf{SAE construction.}
Table~\ref{tab:mechanism-controls}'s core comparisons with other TopK dictionaries (latents as a multiple of the embedding dimension $d$, and $k$ active latents; E5-small, seeds 0--2, $N{=}32$). Eligible: latents per fit with a training firing rate in $[0.02, 0.98]$, the set MI scores. Displ.: normalized squared training displacement of MI-selected SAE-LEACE, and $r^{*}$ the rank of the PCA matched to it. Linear AUC of MI-selected SAE-LEACE (mean $\pm$ sample SD), and the per-seed paired differences to it of random SAE directions (five draws per seed) and of the matched PCA, with 95\% $t$-intervals over seeds. A construction with fewer than 32 eligible latents in some fit cannot be compared at $N{=}32$.
